name: Site Drop
office_task: File every site photo, chat update and bit of paperwork the crew send onto the right job by the job number they wrote on it, and park anything with no clear job for a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and the purchase order (order_id) each item is filed on, e.g. Simpro, ServiceM8, AroFlo or Fergus
the crew chat or office mobile the photos and updates come in on, e.g. a WhatsApp group exported to the office inbox
Xero, for customer and supplier contacts

emits.write: the original photo, chat update or document attached unaltered to the one job or purchase order its written number names, with a docket, quote or invoice's details typed into blank fields only, and the job_id carried
emits.readback: the job system returns the attachment id on the job or order; reading it back by its id returns the attachment, its fingerprint and the entered fields; no id back means it was not filed and an exception is raised

emits.write: the daily close: arrived, filed, parked and duplicates, with the open exceptions oldest first, published on quiet days too
emits.readback: the system the close is published into returns a report_id, and reading it back returns the day and counts that add up

emits.write: one parked item on the filing list with its closed-list reason, the field, both values where they disagree, and the named owner
emits.readback: the exception list returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the arrival, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
